blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
blocks.zh: 对大型语言模型来说,由于文件篇幅长的原因仍然是一项挑战。 标准检索方法本质上是被动反应的,在推论时间带有复杂,跨文件推理的阻滞剂,而预估结构如知识图往往因为依赖僵硬的heuristic而不足. 相反,我们是否可以允许代理人进行预告性的指导性治疗:在推断前学会主动重组无结构的公司,以高效地服务于各种未来的询问. 我们建立在现代代理吊带(如克洛德码)中的关键不对称基础上:虽然LLM代理在导航现有文件系统以解决即时任务方面是精通的,但是他们很少被训练来构建可再用的工作空间供将来使用. 为了即时化这种能力,我们引入了"图书代理"(Liberiary Agents),在这个框架中,一个构建者代理将原始文件转换为合成文件和参考链接的分级文件系统,它构成了适合下游响应代理的工作空间. 我们制定工作空间建设作为马尔可夫决策程序,并通过强化学习优化建设者政策,以直接最大限度地提高下游答题准确度. 经验是,图书馆代理公司在浏览Comp-Plus上比最强的检索和预计算基线高出33个百分点,通过反复查询将前期建筑成本摊还,并以31分平均精度提高的方式将零射入BRIGHT上的看不见域。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with reasoning over extensive corpora of documents, often found in domains such enterprise knowledge bases, complex software repositories, and user chat histories, that exceed the context windows of today’s LLMs. In these domains, the information required to complete a given task is rarely centralized; instead, it is dispersed and disconnected across many disparate sources. Thus, for each incoming request, agents repeatedly process and revisit the corpus from scratch. Can we instead enable systems to efficiently navigate these massive context spaces without incurring high, redundant computational costs each time a user poses a new query?
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地负责对大量文件进行推理,这些文件往往出现在企业知识库、复杂的软件库和用户聊天历史等领域,超出了今天的LLMs的上下文窗口。 在这些领域,完成某项任务所需的信息很少集中;相反,它分散在许多不同来源之间,相互脱节。 因此,对于收到的每一项请求,特工人员都会反复处理,并从头再来重审。 我们能否使系统能够高效地导航这些巨大的上下文空间,而不会在用户每次提出新的查询时引起高额和冗余的计算费用?

blocks.en: A standard approach to this challenge is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , in which a system responds to a query by searching raw documents, retrieving relevant passages, and synthesizing an answer. Recent work has strengthened this pipeline with multi-agent frameworks ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Asai et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Edge et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2025 ) . However, these methods remain largely reactive: each query triggers a new round of search, requiring the model to repeatedly rediscover useful cross-document relationships at inference time. Other approaches pre-structure the search space before inference, for example, as a knowledge graph ( Peng et al., 2025 ) . These methods can improve retrieval, but they typically commit to a rigid set of abstractions such as extracting named entites ( Keraghel et al., 2024 ) . Such a structure is useful when future queries precisely align with the index, but it is less natural when queries require new task-specific intermediate artifacts. A common underlying theme of these approaches is that they impose an inductive bias of structure, which a downstream agent can utilize when answering a given query. We ask can we learn to anticipate this structure for a new set of context that we encounter, curating these documents in a form that that an answering agents can readily use. We propose to directly train an agent to reorganize a corpus into an anticipatory answer-facing workspace so that future LLM agents can efficiently find the right evidence for a query?
blocks.zh: 应对这一挑战的标准方法是检索-增强生成(RAG)(Gao等,2023年),其中一个系统通过搜索原始文件,检索相关段落,并合成一个答案来响应一个查询. 近期的工作用多剂框架加强了这一管道(Jiang等,2023;Asai等,2023;Yan等,2024;Edge等,2024;Singh等,2025)。 然而,这些方法在很大程度上仍然是被动的:每一次查询都触发了新一轮的搜索,要求模型在推断时间反复地重新发现有用的交叉文件关系. 其他方法在推论前先先先安排搜索空间,例如作为知识图(Peng等,2025.). 这些方法可以改进取回,但它们一般会致力于一连串僵硬的抽象,如取出取出命名为entites(Keraghel等,2024.). 当未来的查询与索引完全一致时,这种结构是有用的,但当查询需要新的特定任务中间文物时,这种结构就不那么自然了。 这些方法的一个共同的基本主题是,它们强加一种结构的诱导性偏差,下游代理人在回答某个询问时可以利用. 我们能否学习为我们遇到的一套新的背景来预测这种结构,以一个答复机构能够随时使用的形式来整理这些文件。 我们提议直接训练一个特工 重组一个官司 成为一个预告性的解答工作空间 这样未来的LLM特工 就能有效地找到 正确的证据来查询?

blocks.zh: 图1:图书馆代理概况. (左传). 我们训练一个建筑商 来构建一个工作空间, 由合成的文件和目录组成, 预想未来的查询 一个下游的回答代理。 (权利) 这个工作空间是一次并多次用来回答不同的询问的.

blocks.en: Motivated by approaches that shift computation across different aspects of the model training and deployment process ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Suzgun et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , we study anticipatory workspace construction : the problem of augmenting and reorganizing a corpus before future queries arrive. The goal is to shift part of the costs from query time to a precomputation phase, thereby amortizing these costs across many downstream queries. To instantiate this setting, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework built on a key asymmetry in current agentic systems: LLM agents are effective at navigating existing hierarchical filesystems, but are rarely trained to proactively construct such workspaces for future use . Librarian Agents addresses this gap by tasking a builder agent with transforming source documents into a multi-level workspace with references to the original corpus. An frozen answering agent then navigates this workspace to answer an individual user query. We formalize the builder agent’s operations as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and directly optimize the workspace construction policy for downstream answering performance by posing it as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem on this MDP.
blocks.zh: 以改变模型培训和部署过程不同方面计算的方法为动力(Lin等,2025;Wu等,2026;Suzgun等,2025;Zhang等,2025a),我们研究了预期性工作空间建设: 在未来问询到来之前,增加和重组一项文书的问题。 目标是将部分费用从查询时间转移到预审阶段,从而在下游许多查询中摊还这些费用。 为了即时化这个设置,我们引入了图书馆代理,一个基于当前代理系统中关键不对称的框架: LLM 代理在导航现有分级文件系统方面是有效的,但很少被训练来主动构建这类工作空间供未来使用. . 图书馆代理公司通过委托一个构建者代理公司将源文件转换成多级工作空间,并参照原物来弥补这一缺口. 然后,一个被冻结的回答代理浏览此工作空间,回答单个用户的询问. 并直接优化下游应答性能的工作空间建设政策,

blocks.en: We demonstrate the efficacy of Librarian Agents on BrowseComp-Plus, Librarian Agents improves accuracy by an average of 33 percentage points over the best performing baseline. Furthermore, for BRIGHT, a domain which our builder agent is untrained on, gains persist over baselines with an average 31 point improvement over baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们证明图书馆代理公司在浏览器Comp-Plus上的功效,图书馆代理公司比最佳业绩基准平均提高33个百分点。 此外,对于BRIGHT来说,我们建筑商未受过培训的领域,在基线上不断取得收益,平均比基线提高31分。

blocks.en: In summary, our key contributions are: • We formulate anticipatory workspace construction as a learnable model behavior: agents should materialize useful context as an answer-facing workspace before receiving user queries. • We propose Librarian Agents, a framework where a builder agent synthesizes and organizes memory artifacts into a filesystem-based workspace for future queries. • We formulate filesystem-based workspace construction as an MDP and optimize the builder agent via reinforcement learning to improve downstream query-answering performance. • We evaluate Librarian Agents against retrieval and pre-computation baselines on BrowseComp-Plus and test zero-shot transfer on question-answering tasks derived from BRIGHT.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: • 代理人在接受用户查询之前,应实现有用的背景,作为答复工作空间。 我们建议图书馆代理,一个框架,一个建筑商代理将内存文物合成并组织成一个基于文件系统的工作空间,供将来查询。 我们制定基于文件系统的工作空间构建方案,作为MDP,并通过强化学习来优化构建器剂,来提高下游的问答性能。 我们对照浏览器Comp-Plus上的检索和预计算基线来评价图书馆代理公司,并在BRIGHT产生的回答任务上测试零发传输.

blocks.en: 2 Librarian Agents: Agent Curated Filesystems as Anticipatory Workspaces
blocks.zh: 2 图书代理:代理 Curated 文件系统作为预期工作空间

blocks.en: We introduce Librarian Agents, a framework for training an agent to construct an anticipatory workspace : a filesystem-based memory representation built before future queries arrive. Document-grounded agents can waste compute when each new query forces them to rediscover the same information across the raw corpus. In contrast, can we shift part of this computation by constructing a reusable memory in the form of an anticipatory workspace? We instantiate this by have an gent curate an augmented filesystem that exposes a long-context structure through operations that these agents already use well: using tools to navigate filesystems ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . The builder converts a flat collection of documents into a multi-level workspace whose synthetic files reduce search friction while preserving reference paths to the original corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍图书馆代理公司,这是训练代理公司构建预期工作空间的一个框架:一种基于文件系统的内存表述,在未来查询到来之前建立。 当每个新的查询都迫使他们重新发现原始体中相同的信息时,基于文件的代理人可能会浪费计算。 相比之下,我们是否可以通过构建一个可重复使用的内存,以预想性的工作空间的形式来转移部分计算? 我们通过一个gent 校验一个扩展的文件系统来进行即时分析,通过这些代理已经很好地使用的操作来揭示一个长文本结构:使用工具导航文件系统(Yang等,2024年). 构建者将平面的文档集转换为多层次的工作空间,其合成文件既能减少搜索摩擦,又能保留出原物的参考路径.

blocks.en: We first define the document corpus, filesystem, and augmentation operations that transform a flat collection of raw documents into an answer-facing workspace. We then articulate desiderata of an effective anticipatory memory workspace, which includes coverage with efficient navigation, fallback to raw evidence, and reuse across queries. Finally, we cast workspace construction as a finite-horizon Markov decision process in which the librarian model edits the filesystem to maximize the answering agent’s expected performance on future queries, subject to a construction-cost penalty.
blocks.zh: 我们首先定义了文件本体,文件系统,和增强操作,这些操作将一个平整的原始文件集合转化为一个解答工作空间. 然后,我们阐述一个有效的预期记忆工作空间,包括有效导航的覆盖、原始证据的回落和跨查询的再利用。 最后,我们把工作空间建设作为有限范围马可夫决策程序,图书管理员模式在此过程中编辑文件系统,以最大限度地发挥回答代理对未来查询的预期性能,但须受到施工成本处罚。

blocks.en: 2.1 Problem Setup.
blocks.zh: 2.1 问题设置。

blocks.en: We study long-context reasoning over a corpus of raw documents, 𝒟 = { d 1 , d 2 , … , d n } \mathcal{D}=\{d_{1},d_{2},\ldots,d_{n}\} , where the system must answer queries q ∼ 𝒬 q\sim\mathcal{Q} . This setting matches retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, which typically answer each query by searching over a static retrieval index over 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and then synthesizing a response.

We represent the agent’s external memory as a filesystem-based workspace ℱ \mathcal{F} : a set of files and directories together with metadata specifying each node’s type and parent.
The initial workspace ℱ 0 \mathcal{F}_{0} contains the raw documents in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} as files under the root.
An augmentation 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is an edit operation that modifies a workspace, for example by creating, rewriting, deleting, or moving files and folders. At iteration i i , an augmentation 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} transforms the previous workspace ℱ i − 1 \mathcal{F}_{i-1} into ℱ i \mathcal{F}_{i} . Applying a sequence of augmentations for horizon H H produces a final workspace ℱ H \mathcal{F}_{H} .

blocks.en: Anticipatory workspace construction is the problem of transforming a large corpus into a structured filesystem-based workspace before downstream queries are observed.
blocks.zh: 预想性的工作空间构建是在观测下游查询之前将一大体转化为结构化的基于文件系统的工作空间的问题.

blocks.en: 2.2 Desiderata for Anticipatory Workspaces.
blocks.zh: 2.2 Desiderata用于预期工作空间。

blocks.en: A useful memory should do more than “remember” a corpus. It should reshape the corpus into an answer-facing workspace that helps future agents quickly find relevant evidence while preserving a path back to the raw source documents. As a running example, consider an enterprise corpus containing design docs, issue threads, launch notes, and customer reports for the same product. One future query may ask for a low-level implementation detail; another may ask how a user-visible behavior changed across releases; a third may ask for the exact source that supports a disputed claim. We use these examples to motivate three key desiderata.
blocks.zh: 一个有用的记忆应该比“记住”一项文书更有用。 它应该将本体重塑成一个解答工作空间,帮助未来的特工们迅速找到相关证据,同时保留一条返回原始源文件的路径. 举例来说,考虑一份包含同一产品设计文件、发行线索、发射笔记和客户报告的企业手册。 一个未来的查询可能要求低层次的执行细节;另一个询问用户可见的行为如何在各版之间发生变化;第三个询问支持有争议说法的确切来源。 我们用这些例子来激励三个关键解脱。

blocks.en: Coverage with Efficient Navigation. The memory should cover many plausible queries while reducing the need to search the raw corpus. In the enterprise example, the builder might create a release timeline, a component-level design index, and customer-facing behavior summaries, each linking the same underlying documents from a different angle. These artifacts help only if the answering agent can reach them through short, legible paths, such as directories named by abstraction level. Thus, the builder should synthesize cross-document artifacts that cover likely regions of the query distribution 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} and place them where an agent can discover them with shallow traversal.
blocks.zh: 以高效导航覆盖。 记忆应涵盖许多可信的查询,同时减少搜索原始体的需要。 在企业例子中,构建者可能创建发布时间表,组件级设计指数,以及客户化行为摘要,每个摘要都从不同角度将相同的基础文档相连接. 这些文物只有在答录代理能够通过短而可辨识的路径,例如由抽象级命名的目录来达到它们时才有帮助. 因此,构建者应该合成覆盖查询分布 Q\ mathcal{Q} 可能区域的跨文档文物,并将它们放置在一个能用浅的横道来发现它们的代理.

blocks.en: Faithful Fallback. No finite memory can anticipate every query, and synthesized artifacts can omit details that are critical in hindsight. The workspace must therefore preserve reference links and raw source paths so the answering agent can verify claims or bypass the synthesized layer when needed. In the enterprise example, a rare query about a single customer may not appear in the high-level summary, but the agent should still be able to read any existing issue thread. As an extreme example, such a fallback is important for needle-in-a-haystack queries where the answer depends on a localized, very specific fact that is unlikely to survive compression ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 忠实倒地. 任何有限的内存都无法预测每个查询,而被合成的文物也可以省略出后视中至关重要的细节. 因此,工作空间必须保存参考链接和原始源路径,以便应答代理在需要时可以验证要求或绕过被合成的层. 在企业实例中,关于单一客户的罕见的查询可能没有出现在高端摘要中,但代理商仍应当能够读取任何已存在的问题线索. 作为极端的例子,这样的倒置对于针入海斯塔克的询问很重要,因为答案取决于一个局部的,非常具体的事实,而这个事实不可能在压缩中幸存(Wang等,2024年).

blocks.en: Amortized Reuse. The builder’s construction cost should pay off across many downstream queries. For example, a compact release timeline written by the builder agent may help answer many questions about regressions, roadmap changes, customer messaging, and dependency updates. In contrast, a one-off answer draft may surface similar information but help only a single request. This creates a tradeoff between the construction cost ∑ i = 1 H Cost ⁡ ( 𝒜 i ) \sum_{i=1}^{H}\mathrm{Cost}(\mathcal{A}_{i}) and the downstream utility.
blocks.zh: 摊还再用. 建筑商的建筑成本应该能够解决下游的许多问题。 例如,由构建者代理撰写的紧凑发布时间表可能有助于回答关于回归,行进图更改,客户信息传递,以及依赖性更新的许多问题. 与此相反,一次性答复草案可能显示类似信息,但只帮助一项请求。 这在建设成本 \ i = 1 H 成本 \ (A i )\ sum\ i = 1\ sum\ (H + mathrm{ Cost} (\ mathcal{ A}_{i}) 和下游公用事业之间创造了取舍。

blocks.en: An effective anticipatory workspace should make likely queries easy to answer, preserve fallback paths to raw documents, and pay off across many downstream queries.
blocks.zh: 一个有效的预期工作空间应使可能的查询容易回答,保留原始文件的倒行逆施路径,并解决下游的许多查询。

blocks.en: 2.3 Workspace MDP Formalization.
blocks.zh: 2.3 工作空间 MDP 正规化。

blocks.en: In Librarian Agents, anticipatory workspace construction proceeds in two phases: an upfront synthesis phase and a downstream answering phase. The synthesis phase is analogous to the offline construction of a retrieval index or knowledge graph, but instead produces a flexible filesystem-based workspace. To instantiate this idea, we define a builder agent π build ​ ( 𝒜 ∣ ℱ ) \pi_{\text{build}}(\mathcal{A}\mid\mathcal{F}) , which proposes augmentations given the current workspace, and an answering agent π ans ​ ( y ~ ∣ q , ℱ ) \pi_{\text{ans}}(\tilde{y}\mid q,\mathcal{F}) , which generates an answer y ~ \tilde{y} for a new query q q using the constructed workspace.

blocks.en: State, Action, and Transition Dynamics. At each timestep t t , the state is the current filesystem ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} , consisting of the original raw documents 𝒟 \mathcal{D} together with the synthetic files, folders, and reference links created so far. The builder agent selects an augmentation 𝒜 t ∼ π build ( ⋅ ∣ ℱ t ) \mathcal{A}_{t}\sim\pi_{\text{build}}(\cdot\mid\mathcal{F}_{t}) , which is applied to the filesystem to produce ℱ t + 1 \mathcal{F}_{t+1} . We constrain the builder to the following discrete action types that can each be applied to different files: • CreateFile : Creates a new synthetic file by consolidating information from a subset of raw documents and/or existing synthetic files. The file has reference links to the set of sources used to construct it. • MergeFiles : Aggregates a set of related synthetic files into a higher-level summary or directory-like artifact. This action introduces hierarchy, linking to child files. • Delete : Removes redundant/unhelpful synthetic files from the active answer-facing workspace. This operation never deletes raw documents in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , preserving fallback access. • Stop : Terminates memory construction, returning the current workspace ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} as the final memory artifact to use for the downstream answering agent. The action types here is intentionally constrained to reduce the horizon for optimization. In principle, this interface can be generalized to a broader set of atomic filesystem commands (e.g., touch , mkdir , mv , rm , etc). We describe the instantiation of these actions in the filesystem in Appendix A.8 .

blocks.en: We formulate memory construction as an MDP in which periodic answerability changes and terminal answer correctness provide credit for useful filesystem edits; the general objective can additionally incorporate navigation and construction costs.

blocks.en: 2.4 Workspace Augmentations via RL.
blocks.zh: 2.4 通过RL进行工作空间增强。

blocks.en:
The MDP formulation above enables direct optimization of the workspace construction process with reinforcement learning.
In each rollout, the builder iteratively edits the workspace for up to H H steps, producing a trajectory τ = ( ℱ 0 , 𝒜 1 , ℱ 1 , … , 𝒜 T , ℱ T ) , \tau=(\mathcal{F}_{0},\mathcal{A}_{1},\mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{A}_{T},\mathcal{F}_{T}), (5) where T ≤ H T\leq H is determined either by the horizon or the Stop action.
blocks.zh:
上面的MDP配制可以直接优化工作空间建设过程并进行强化学习.
在每次推出时,构建者会迭代地编辑H级以下的工作空间,生成出一个正轨 = (F 0, A 1, F 1, ..., A T, F T ),\tau= (\ mathcal{F}_{0},\ mathcal{A}_{1},\ mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\ mathcal{A}_{T},\mathcal{F}_{T}), (5) 其中T≤ H T\leq H是由地平线或停止动作决定的.

blocks.en: The resulting workspace is then evaluated by the answering agent on a minibatch of queries sampled from 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} . These queries are used only for reward estimation and are not provided to the builder during construction. In the primary configuration, the builder receives periodic answerability-delta rewards together with the terminal answer score. This hybrid signal approximates the dense objective while avoiding an expensive answering evaluation after every workspace edit. This training signal encourages the builder to discover workspace edits that are not merely locally coherent but also useful for improving downstream question answering. When α > 0 \alpha>0 , the objective additionally trades these improvements against construction cost. We optimize the builder policy with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , a policy-gradient method used for RL-based fine-tuning of language models.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的工作空间随后由答题代理对从Q\mathcal\\\ 抽取的一小批查询进行评估。 这些查询仅用于奖励估计,施工期间不提供给建筑商. 在主配置中,构建者与终端解答分数一起获得定期解答-delta奖励. 这个混合信号大致反映了密集的目标,同时避免每次工作空间编辑后出现昂贵的回答评价. 这个训练信号鼓励建造者发现工作空间编辑,这些编辑不仅具有当地的一致性,而且有助于改进下游问题的回答。 当α > 0\alpha>0时,目标又将这些改进与建筑成本相交换。 我们通过GRPO(Shao等,2024年)优化了建设者政策,这是一种用于基于RL的精细化语言模型的政策分级方法.

blocks.en: By default, we treat the answering agent π ans \pi_{\text{ans}} as fixed during builder optimization. This isolates the learning problem: the builder learns to construct memories that are useful to the answering agent, which may be a language model or another long-context reasoning system such as RLM ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . We can also consider an alternative joint-training variant in which the answering agent is adapted using the same downstream correctness signal. In this setting, optimization can alternate between updating the builder and updating the answerer via a cooperative multi-agent RL framework, following methods such as RLAD ( Qu et al., 2025a ) . The full optimization process is outlined in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh: 默认情况下, 在构建器优化时, 我们将答题代理 { ans\ pi\ text{ ans} 视为固定 。 这孤立了学习问题:构建者学会了构建对答录代理有用的记忆,这可能是语言模型,也可能是RLM(张等,2025a. 我们还可以考虑另一种联合训练的变体,即使用相同的下游正确信号来调整答录剂. 在此设置中,优化可以在更新构建器和通过合作多代理RL框架更新解答器之间取而代之,遵循RLAD(Qu等,2025a.)等方法. 完全优化过程在算法 1 中概述.

blocks.en: We optimize the builder as an LLM policy over filesystem edits. Each rollout constructs a memory, evaluates it with a fixed answering agent, and updates the builder with GRPO using periodic answerability changes and terminal answer correctness.
blocks.zh: 我们优化了构建器作为LLM政策,而不是文件系统编辑. 每次推出会构建一个内存,用固定的答录代理来评价它,并使用定期的可答性变化和终端答录正确性来用GPRO更新构建者.

blocks.en: Having formulated anticipatory workspace construction as an MDP in Section 2 , we evaluate whether Librarian Agents improves the reasoning performance and inference efficiency of downstream answering agents on long-context document reasoning tasks. We compare Librarian Agents with prior reactive retrieval and pre-computation methods to address four questions: (1) Does Librarian Agents improve in-distribution long-context reasoning performance? (2) What amortization benefits do Librarian Agents provide when serving multiple queries over a shared document set? (3) Does the builder agent’s anticipatory construction capability generalize zero-shot to out-of-distribution retrieval settings? (4) Qualitatively, how do the builder and answering agents behave during the construction and answering phases, and do these behaviors reflect the intended anticipatory capability? We examine each question in turn below.
blocks.zh: 第2节中将预测性工作空间建设作为MDP, 我们评价图书馆代理是否提高了下游应答代理的推理性能和推论效率, 我们比较图书馆代理与前反应检索和预计算方法,以解决四个问题: (1)"图书代理"是否改进了分录长篇推理表现?. (2) 图书馆代理公司在向共享文件集提供多重查询时提供哪些摊还福利? (3)建材代理的预期构造能力是否将零射入分流取回设置中? (4)在质地上,建设者和应答代理在构建和应答阶段的表现如何,这些行为是否反映了预期的预期能力? 我们依次审查每个问题。

blocks.en: Task Definition. The main domain we consider for long-document reasoning is BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , a curated corpus of deep-research web tasks. We split this dataset into two sets for training and evaluation: 680 tasks for training and 50 held-out tasks for all evaluations (sampled at random). For training π build \pi_{\text{build}} , each task consists of an independent set of raw documents and a downstream query to be answered based on the set of documents. We additionally evaluate the performance of Librarian Agents on the BRIGHT Benchmark ( Su et al., 2025 ) , which comprises tasks from diverse domains (StackExchange, LeetCode, and math competitions), to assess the builder agent’s efficacy on unseen distributions.

blocks.en: Comparisons and baselines. We evaluate our approach against several representative baselines. First, we compare with standard reactive retrieval methods: an Embedding with optional Reranker baseline ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) and Late Interaction Embedding ( Chaffin and Sourty, 2025 ) , which represent conventional retrieve-and-read RAG systems that process each query from scratch. Second, we compare with Graph RAG ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , a knowledge graph baseline that uses precomputation. Third, we include Agentic RAG ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , which represents multi-agent approaches that dynamically interleave retrieval and reasoning at query time. Next, we compare autocompaction methods such as those that periodically summarize the computation performed, such as RC ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . These baselines cover both ends of the design space, with some doing all cross-document reasoning per query and others doing it once up front. We also include an ablation of our own framework: a builder agent without RL fine-tuning . This isolates the contribution of our MDP-based policy optimization. For all methods, the downstream answering agents, Qwen3.5-4B and Gemini 3.1 Flash lite, are kept frozen so that performance differences reflect only the quality of the resulting memory artifacts. More details on the baselines and hyperparameters are available in Appendix A.7 .
blocks.zh: 比较和基线。 我们对照若干有代表性的基线评估我们的做法。 首先,我们比较标准的反应式检索方法:一种带有可选的Reranker基线的嵌入(Zhang等,2025c)和Late Interactive Embedding(Chaffin and Sourty,2025),它们代表了传统的取回并读取的RAG系统,从头处理每个查询. 第二,我们与使用预算的知识图基线RAG(Peng等人,2025年)进行比较。 第三,我们包括Agentic RAG(Singh等人,2025年),它代表了在查询时动态地互放检索和推理的多代理方法. 其次,我们比较自动比较方法,如定期总结计算结果的方法,如RC(Wu等,2026年)。 这些基线覆盖了设计空间的两端,有的进行每个查询的所有跨文件推理,有的进行一次前置. 我们还包括了我们自己的框架:一个没有RL微调的建造者代理人。 这孤立了我们基于多边发展方案的政策优化的贡献。 对所有方法来说,下游的应答代理Qwen3.5-4B和双子座3.1 Flash lite被保持被冻结,这样性能差异就只反映所形成的内存文物的质量. 关于基线和超参数的更详细情况见附录A.7。

Crucially, the ablation without RL fine-tuning (No FT) additionally underperforms below Librarian Agents, highlights that policy optimization with RL is essential for teaching the builder agent to structure memories effectively for downstream consumption, a task the base model was not trained for.

(2) Memory reuse and cost per correct answer. Filesystem construction is a one-time cost that helps all queries using the same document set.
We therefore measure the amortized cost in a dataset we extend so that each document set serves multiple queries.
As shown in Table 2 , Librarian Agents incurs an upfront construction cost of 179K tokens and achieves an accuracy of 0.77, compared with 0.36 and 0.04, respectively. To examine how this cost is distributed when a filesystem is reused, we evaluate 443 frozen synthetic queries across 50 document sets, with 7–10 queries per document set, generated by Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite few-shot prompted with sample DeepDive ( Lu et al., 2025 ) questions. On these queries, the same evaluation filesystems yield an accuracy of 0.64 versus 0.24 for the base builder at an answer-time cost of 9.3K tokens per query. At a hypothetical reuse load of 20 queries per document set, spreading the reported construction cost across those queries gives a projected total of roughly 18K tokens per query (Table 2 ). Because the answering agent reads a richer filesystem, raw per-query token counts remain higher than with the base builder. After normalizing for accuracy, Librarian Agents uses 33.8% fewer recorded tokens per expected correct answer at ten questions per corpus (RL/Base ratio 0.662, 95% CI [0.504, 0.836]) as shown in Appendix A.4 .

blocks.en: (3) Transfer of Builder Agent to novel long-context document reasoning setting. To assess whether the builder agent learns a generalized anticipatory capability rather than simply overfitting to the DeepResearch training distribution, we evaluate Librarian Agents zero-shot on the BRIGHT benchmark. Here, we study 150 questions spanning 3 domains with 50 per domain, with one filesystem per domain (also studying amortization). As detailed in Table 3 , the RL-finetuned builder agent successfully transfers to highly out-of-distribution domains such as biology and math problem solving. Librarian Agents achieves an average pass@1 accuracy of 0.52 and pass@3 accuracy of 0.67 across the 3 BRIGHT datasets, outperforming baselines. These results confirm that framing memory construction as an MDP enables the builder to learn fundamental, transferable heuristics for organizing information, which remain robust even when encountering novel, unseen documents.
blocks.zh: (3)将构建器代理转移到了新颖的长文本文档推理设置. 为了评估建设者代理人是否学习了一种普遍的预期能力,而不是仅仅过度适应了"深度研究"的训练分配,我们评价了图书馆代理公司在BRIGHT基准上的零射入. 在这里,我们研究150个问题,涉及3个域,每个域有50个,每个域有1个文件系统(也研究分期偿还). 如表3所详述的,RL-finetuned 构建器代理成功转移到高度分散的领域,如生物学和数学问题的解决. 图书馆代理在3个BRIGHT数据集中平均通过@1精度为0.52,通过@3精度为0.67,超过基准. 这些结果证实,将内存构建作为一个MDP框架,使建设者能够学习组织信息的基本、可转移的热度,即使在遇到新颖的、看不见的文件时,这种热度依然强劲。

blocks.en: The structural statistics on BRIGHT further show that RL substantially changes construction behavior. Across the 3 sub-domains, the trained builder produces richer hierarchical memories, averaging 53.4 active synthetic files organized into 45.4 clusters and 8.0 merged artifacts, compared with 4.8 files, 4.2 clusters, and 0.6 merges for the base builder.
blocks.zh: BRIGHT的结构统计进一步表明,RL大大地改变了建筑行为. 在3个子域中,训练有素的建设者产生更丰富的分级记忆,平均53.4个活性合成文件被组织成45.4个集群和8.0个被合并的文物,而基建者则有4.8个文档,4.2个集群,0.6个被合并.

On BrowseComp-Plus, the base model creates a fragmented filesystem that is difficult for the answering agent to navigate, whereas the RL-trained builder surfaces relevant information in dedicated files and produces a richer, more ergonomic organization.

Figure 2 illustrates that the trained builder combines broad topical coverage with hierarchical organization. Tables 4 and 5 complement this view by distinguishing answering-agent retrieval (the synthetic files and tokens read) from builder structure (the active files, clusters, and merges it produces). Broad coverage expands the range of future queries the memory can support, while hierarchical organization makes fine-grained evidence easier to locate.

The trained builder creates a broader, more coherent set of query-relevant artifacts, while the base policy leaves a fragmented organization that is harder for the answering agent to navigate.

blocks.en: Our evaluation shows that Librarian Agents improves long-context document reasoning in-domain, transfers to BRIGHT, amortizes construction cost across repeated queries, and learns memory structures that remain navigable when synthetic coverage is incomplete.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价显示,"图书馆代理"改进了长文本文档在域内推理,向BRIGHT转移,通过反复询问对建筑成本进行摊还,并学习了在合成覆盖不完整时仍可通航的内存结构.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation. RAG grounds language model outputs in external evidence, mitigating the limitations of purely parametric memory ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Oche et al., 2025 ) . Recent innovations have evolved this pipeline into agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Singh et al., 2025 ) . For instance, models can now predict upcoming content to trigger searches ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , use reflection tokens for self-critique ( Asai et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) , or execute planned searches to navigate multi-hop questions ( Li et al., 2026b ) . However, these approaches initiate complex, iterative retrieval only after receiving a user query. In contrast, Librarian Agents front-loads this computational burden by proactively synthesizing a structured, query-agnostic filesystem prior to inference, amortizing the cost of corpus-level reasoning.
blocks.zh: 取取相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 RAG将语言模型输出结果作为外部证据的依据,减轻了纯参数记忆的局限性(Lewis等,2020;Gao等,2023;Li等,2025;Oche等,2025)。 最近的革新使这一管道发展成为能够多步推理的代理系统(徐等,2024;张等,2025b;辛格等,2025.). 例如,模型现在可以预测即将出现的内容以触发搜索(Jiang等,2023年),使用反射符来进行自我批评(Asai等,2023年;Yan等,2024年),或者执行计划中的搜索来导航多跳问题(Li等,2026年b). 然而,这些方法只有在收到用户查询后才启动复杂的迭代检索。 相形之下,图书馆代理公司通过在推论前主动合成一个结构分明,查询-不可知的文件系统,摊还了实体级推理的成本,从而将这种计算负担放在了前列.

blocks.en: Structured Indexes and Corpus-Level Organization. Prior systems precompute corpus structure: RAPTOR builds hierarchical summaries ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) ; GraphRAG and related methods construct entity graphs and community summaries ( Edge et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) ; and HippoRAG builds graph-structured memory ( Jiménez Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) . Although valuable, these preprocessing methods rely heavily on rigid, rule-based extraction pipelines or predefined schemas. In contrast, Librarian Agents make anticipatory memory construction fully agentic and optimizable. Librarian Agents treats the structure itself as a learned decision, with a builder that chooses its own files and hierarchy and is rewarded by how well a later agent answers.
blocks.zh: 结构化指数和公司级组织。 先前的系统预计算结构:RAPTOR建立分级摘要(Sarthi等,2024年);GraphRAG和相关方法构建实体图表和社区摘要(Edge等,2024年;Li等,2024年;Guo等,2025年;HippoRAG建立图结构记忆(Jiménez Gutiérrez等,2024年)。 这些预处理方法虽然很有价值,但严重依赖僵硬的,有章可循的取出管或预定义的取出计划. 相形之下,图书馆代理公司使预期记忆构造完全具有代理性和可选择性. 图书馆代理公司将结构本身视为一个有学问的决定,由建筑商来选择自己的文件和等级,并以后来的代理公司回答的好评来奖励.

blocks.en: Long-Term Memory for Language Agents. Prior work explores endowing language models with persistent, stateful memory to support continuous operation. For instance, recent works propose to cache conversational histories ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2023 ; Uddin et al., 2026 ) , manage virtual context windows via memory tiers ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , and unify short- and long-term memory directly within the agent’s policy ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . However, these approaches primarily focus on an agent retaining its own historical context. Librarian Agents addresses a different setting, in which the memory is written over an external corpus ahead of time and judged by how well another agent answers from it.
blocks.zh: 语言代理长期记忆. 先前的工作探索了赋予语言模型以持续,状态的内存以支持连续操作. 例如,近期的作品建议缓存对话史(Wang等,2023;Zhong等,2023;Uddin等,2026;),通过内存分级管理虚拟上下文窗口(Packer等,2023;),并在代理政策范围内直接统一短期和长期内存(Yu等,2026b;Xu等,2025;). 然而,这些办法主要侧重于保留其自身历史背景的代理人。 图书馆代理处理的是不同的环境,其中内存是提前被写在外文包上,并根据另一个代理如何从中解答来判断.

blocks.en: Compute Reallocation. Our approach aligns with emerging literature on reallocating computation across time to improve test-time scaling ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Other approaches formalize test-time compute optimization as meta-reinforcement learning optimization to adaptively allocate tokens ( Qu et al., 2025b ) or utilize self-curated test-time curricula to reinforce successful strategies ( Hübotter et al., 2025 ) . To our knowledge, Librarian Agents is the first to treat corpus organization as a policy optimized for downstream answers, training a builder to do once what an answering agent would otherwise repeat for every query. Our hyperparameters explicitly control how construction cost and query-time cost are weighed against answer accuracy.
blocks.zh: 计算重新定位。 我们的方法与不断出现的关于重新配置计算时间的文献保持一致,以改进测试时间的尺度(Lin等,2025;Wu等,2026;Yan等,2026;Yu等,2026a;Li等,2026a)。 其他办法将测试时间计算优化正规化,作为元强化学习优化,以适应性地分配征兆(Qu等,2025b)或利用自订测试时间课程来加强成功的战略(Hübotter等,2025年)。 据我们所知, 图书馆代理公司是第一个 将实体组织视为一项政策 优化下游答案, 我们的超参数明确控制如何权衡建筑成本和查询时间成本与答题准确性。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论、限制和未来工作

blocks.en: We study the capability of anticipatory directed curation , in which agents can proactively reorganize their context into a memory artifact optimized for future queries they encounter. To instantiate this capability, we rely on an asymmetry for agents today, where agents are trained to navigate a filesystem for a given task, yet do not pre-construct workspaces for future queries that they might encounter. Our novel framework, Librarian Agents, introduces a builder agent that creates a synthetic filesystem that an answering agent can navigate. Librarian Agents yields consistent improvements on BrowseComp-Plus and BRIGHT, outperforming existing retrieval methods on both in-domain and out-of-distribution evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了预想式定向治疗的能力,其中特工人员可以主动地将其背景重新组织成一个最优化的记忆文物,以备今后遇到的询问。 为了即时发挥这种能力,我们依靠今天特工的不对称性,即特工们接受过训练来为特定任务导航一个文件系统,然而却不会为将来可能遇到的询问预先构建工作空间. 我们的小说框架"图书馆代理"引入了一个构建者代理,它创建了一个合成文件系统,一个应答代理能够导航. 图书馆代理公司对浏览器Comp-Plus和BRIGHT的不断改进,在域内和分配外评价方面都比现有检索方法有效果。

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to question answering over static corpora, and maintaining anticipatory memories as documents change remains an open problem. The builder agent also operates over a large file context, which may limit scalability, though pairing Librarian Models with clustering or retrieval could extend the framework to larger domains. Since no finite set of synthesized artifacts can anticipate every query, compression may discard details needed for needle-in-a-haystack tasks; we preserve reference links for fallback access, but deciding when to bypass the synthetic filesystem remains a challenge. A natural extension is a filesystem that updates from its own traffic, treating each answered query as evidence of what the next reader will need. Future work could also let the builder compose atomic filesystem commands, of which its current four actions are special cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价仅限于对静态公司的答复提出疑问,随着文件的改变而保持预测性记忆仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 构建器代理也运行在一个大的文件上下文上,这可能限制可扩展性,尽管将图书模型配对成集群或检索可以将框架扩展到更大的域. 由于没有一组有限的被合成的文物可以预见到每一个查询,压缩可能会丢弃针入海斯塔克任务所需的细节;我们保留回落访问的参考链接,但决定何时绕出合成文件系统仍然是一个挑战. 一个自然扩展是一个文件系统,从自己的流量中更新,将每个被回答的查询作为下一个读者需要什么的证据. 未来的工作还可以让构建者来作曲原子文件系统命令,其中其目前的四个动作是特例.

blocks.en: BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) pairs document collections with questions that require locating and combining information distributed across those collections. We train the filesystem builder on 680 corpus-level tasks and reserve 50 previously unseen corpus-level tasks, for evaluation. We use a mixture of evidence, gold, and negative docs for each representative task, following the composition in the original dataset. During construction, the builder receives only the documents and never observes the evaluation questions. The completed filesystem is then reused for every question associated with its corpus. We report failure-inclusive binary semantic answer correctness against the fixed reference answers, so unsuccessful constructions and failed generations remain in the denominator. In addition, for the Base-versus-RL comparison, both builders receive identical construction limits, and we report realized construction tokens separately because equal limits do not imply equal consumption.

blocks.en: BRIGHT spans technical, scientific, mathematical, and programming domains with substantially different document and query distributions ( Su et al., 2025 ) . We convert its retrieval instances into a generation task by associating each query with a fixed reference answer and scoring generated responses for semantic correctness. For the primary matched-baseline evaluation, we use 150 questions spanning three domains, with 50 questions each from AOPS, Biology, and Stack Overflow. To test cross-benchmark transfer, we apply the BrowseComp-trained Librarian zero-shot: it constructs one reusable filesystem per domain without observing any evaluation question, and this single shared filesystem supports all questions in that domain. We compare the Librarian against matched retrieval baselines, generating four independent responses per question and reporting both mean per-response accuracy, which estimates pass@1, and unbiased pass@3 estimated from the four generated responses, which we compute using the numerically stable estimator from Codex ( Chen et al., 2021 ) .

blocks.en: For the primary BrowseComp-Plus experiment, we optimize a Qwen3.5-4B builder with GRPO on the 680-task training split. We use LoRA rank 32, a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , batch size 8, rollout-group size 4, and a maximum construction horizon of 32 builder turns. Builder generations are limited to 1,024 tokens and complete construction trajectories to 60,000 tokens. The CreateFile and MergeFiles operations use a fixed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B content executor, and long builder histories are compacted by a fixed Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite model. The answering agent and evaluator also remain fixed throughout builder optimization.
blocks.zh: 对于主浏览器Comp-Plus实验,我们在680任务分拆上优化了使用GRPO的Quen3.5-4B构建器. 我们使用LORA第32名,学习率为4×10−5 4\times 10×5},批量尺寸为8,推出组大小为4,最大建造地平线为32个建造者转弯. 建造者世代受限于1024个活字,完整的活字建筑轨距为6万个活字. CreateFile和MergeFiles操作使用一个固定的Quen3.5-35B-A3B内容执行器,而长长的构建器历史由固定的双子座3.1 Flash Lite模型收缩. 答录机和评价员在整个构建器优化过程中也保持不变。

blocks.en: The training reward measures the downstream usefulness of the evolving filesystem. We probe answerability every eight builder turns, with at most four probes per construction trajectory, and assign reward according to the change in answerability between consecutive probes. A terminal reward evaluates the final filesystem using downstream answer correctness. We use γ = 1 \gamma=1 and no explicit filesystem-structure reward, navigation-cost reward, or construction-cost shaping in the primary run ( α = 0 \alpha=0 ). Filesystem maturity, organization, and navigation measurements reported in the analysis are therefore diagnostic statistics rather than direct components of the optimization objective.

blocks.en: A.8 Tool Definitions for Filesystem Action Space
blocks.zh: A.8 文件系统行动空间的工具定义

blocks.en: The builder agent interacts with the filesystem by delegating a limited set of discrete operations to specialized tool-calling agents. These tools are made available to the builder LLM through structured JSON schemas and can be invoked as needed. We follow the Qwen Tool Calling Format: https://qwen.readthedocs.io/en/latest/framework/function_call.html .
blocks.zh: 构建器代理通过将一组有限的离散操作委托给专门的调用工具代理来与文件系统交互. 这些工具通过结构化的JSON schemas提供给建设者LLM,必要时可以被引用. 我们遵循Quen工具调用格式:https://qwen.readthedocs.io/en/latest/framework/unction_call.html。

blocks.en: The CREATEFILE tool creates a new synthetic file by consolidating information from selected raw documents and/or existing synthetic files. The resulting file is added to the hierarchy and includes provenance links to the sources used to generate it. The MERGEFILES tool combines related synthetic files into a higher-level artifact, such as a summary, index, or directory-like file. This operation introduces hierarchical structure while preserving links to the underlying child files, which become nested under the new summary file.
blocks.zh: CREATEFILE工具通过合并取自所选原始文档和(或)已存在的合成文件的信息来创建一个新的合成文件. 由此产生的文件被添加到分层中,并包含出处链接到用来生成它的来源. MERGEFILES工具将相關的合成文件集成到更高级别的文物中来,例如汇总,索引,或类似目录的文件. 这一操作引入了分级结构,同时保留了基础儿童文件的链接,这些文件成为了新摘要文件下窝.

blocks.en: The DELETE tool removes redundant or unhelpful synthetic files from the active, answer-facing filesystem. It never deletes raw documents in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , ensuring that the original corpus remains available as a fallback. Finally, the STOP tool ends the memory-construction process and returns the current filesystem ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} as the final memory artifact.
blocks.zh: DELETE工具从活动,可答文件系统中去除冗余或无益的合成文件. 它从不删除 D\ mathcal{ D} 中的原始文档, 保证原始内容作为倒置保留 。 最后,STOP工具结束了内存构建过程,并将当前文件系统F t\ mathcal{F}_{t}作为最后的内存文物返回.

blocks.zh: 我们利用代理人的功能调用能力来使用这些专门的子剂,每个子剂都执行一种单独的工具.
